info.name: TKGM Parsel Sorgu (Land Registry)
info.description:
The official Turkish land registry (TKGM) parcel query API — the single reference for Parcel Atlas. Import this file into Postman (File > Import) to run the requests.

Base: https://cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api
Every call is a plain GET: no token, no auth header.

ACCESS POLICY (why native/Postman work and the web app does not):
The registry answers 200 to clients that send NO website origin — native apps, curl, and Postman — and returns 403 with the text "Günlük sorgu limitini aştınız" to a browser request that carries another website's origin. A browser always stamps the page's origin on the request and JavaScript cannot remove it (Origin is a forbidden header), so the web app cannot look parcels up directly; the desktop and mobile builds can, because they are not browsers. Verified 2026-11-15 on one connection within the same minute: no-origin 200, foreign browser origin 403.

Usage rule: the daily limit is per connection (IP) and low. Query only on purpose — never on map move, on a timer, or in a loop.

request.description: Fetch one parcel by its neighbourhood id, block (ada) and parcel number. Path: parsel/{mahalleId}/{ada}/{parsel}. The example queries Düzköy (mahalleId 130241), ada 114, parsel 1. Answers one GeoJSON Feature (Polygon + properties). This is what the app's Refresh-by-number uses.

Fetch the parcel under a WGS84 coordinate. Path: parsel/{lat}/{lng}/ (note the trailing slash). Returns 200 with one GeoJSON Feature when a parcel covers the point, or 404 when none does. This is what one tap on uncovered ground uses in the app.

item.name: Neighborhood list for a district (find mahalle id)

request.description: List the neighbourhoods (mahalle) of a district (ilçe). Path: idariYapi/mahalleListe/{ilceId}. The example lists İspir (ilçe 408). Use it to find the mahalleId needed by the parcel-by-number request. Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection; each feature's id is the mahalleId.
